item.title: Iran claims victory as U.S. shifts to economic pressure
item.description: Iran's president said the world acknowledged its victory, while VP Vance called economic measures the most effective approach.

item.title: Lifeguard in Aruba rescues three family members
item.description: A lifeguard saved three people after their tubing trip turned dangerous when one tube collided with a boat.

item.title: Trump's 50% tariffs begin after U.S.-Canada talks fail
item.description: Tariffs take effect early Saturday after Trump extended the deadline by three days, but no deal was reached.

item.title: Rescued spider monkeys settle into Nashville Zoo
item.description: Endangered Mexican spider monkeys Miso, Matcha, and Mei get a fresh start after being rescued from illegal trade.
